common_meaning: Enjoyment, amusement or light-hearted pleasure; also (informally) enjoyable.
example: The game was a lot of fun, even though we lost.
rrgm_bridge: Fun is pleasure taken in the doing itself, not in what the doing achieves.
invariant_mi: Enjoyment arising from an activity valued for itself.

domain_entries.AFF: A light positive state of amusement and engagement. Parity line: whether a given system has this felt state is [UNK] under the Symmetry Rule; the behavioural markers can be described either way. Provisional domain.
domain_entries.REL: Shared fun builds bonds; play between people tests and strengthens trust.

count_condition: An activity or experience that is enjoyed for its own sake.
transfer_boundary: "Making fun of" someone means mocking them, which is not fun for its target. Fun for one party can be harm for another; the word does not settle whose experience counts.

common_meaning: Having previously been something, but no longer; or, as "the former", the first of two things mentioned.
example: She met her former teacher at the station.
rrgm_bridge: Former keeps the record of a past state while marking that it no longer holds; the history stays, the role ends.
invariant_mi: Previously holding a role or state that has since ended.

domain_entries.REL: A former partner, colleague or office-holder keeps a history with others while the role itself has ended.
domain_entries.LIN: "The former ... the latter" refers back to the first and second of two items.

count_condition: A person or thing that once had a role or state and no longer has it.
transfer_boundary: Former does not erase what was: the history remains true. A former role is not an ongoing claim.

common_meaning: A story or event recorded as moving images to be shown in a cinema or on a screen; also a thin layer, or the material once used in cameras.
example: We watched a film about the moon landing; a film of dust covered the shelf.
rrgm_bridge: A film fixes moving images in sequence so a story can be replayed for others.
invariant_mi: A recorded motion picture, or a thin covering layer.

domain_entries.DIG: Digital filmmaking and streaming have replaced most physical film.
domain_entries.REL: Films shape shared stories and how groups see each other.
domain_entries.PHY: A thin layer of a substance on a surface.

count_condition: A motion picture, or a thin coating.
transfer_boundary: A film based on true events is still a constructed story; it is free fiction aimed at the real, not a record.

common_meaning: After a long time or delay; also as the last in a series.
example: The bus finally arrived; finally, add the salt.
rrgm_bridge: Finally marks the end of a wait or the last step of a sequence.
invariant_mi: At the end, after delay or after other steps.

domain_entries.LIN: Signals relief after delay, or orders the last point in a list.

count_condition: An event at the end of a wait, or the last item in a sequence.
transfer_boundary: "Finally" can hint at impatience; it carries feeling as well as order.

common_meaning: Relating to a system of government in which power is divided between a central government and states or provinces.
example: Federal and provincial governments share responsibility for health.
rrgm_bridge: Federal names a structure of layered authority: a centre and member parts, each with its own powers.
invariant_mi: Of a union of self-governing units with a central government.

domain_entries.REL: Federalism divides power so that no single level holds all of it.
domain_entries.ECO: Federal budgets and taxes sit alongside state or provincial ones.

count_condition: A government or system made of member units under a shared central authority.
transfer_boundary: Which powers are federal and which are local varies by country and is often disputed.

common_meaning: A team game played with a ball; in most of the world, the game also called soccer; in North America, American or Canadian football.
example: They play football in the park on Sundays.
rrgm_bridge: Football names different games in different places; the word follows local custom.
invariant_mi: A team ball game, or the ball used in it.

domain_entries.REL: Football clubs carry strong local and national identities.
domain_entries.ECO: Professional football is a large industry.

count_condition: A ball game of the type called football locally, or its ball.
transfer_boundary: Which game "football" means depends on where the speaker lives.
